name: @penmoss/telemetry-dashboard
description: Usage analytics' dashboard (PEN-137) on stats.penmoss.app: a read-only Worker behind Cloudflare Access that runs the named queries, and its one page

scripts.dev: node build.mjs && wrangler dev --local --port $(node ../../scripts/ports.mjs dashboard) --inspector-port $(node ../../scripts/ports.mjs inspector)
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p . && tsc --noEmit -p src/client && tsc --noEmit -p test/client && tsc --noEmit -p test/e2e && tsc --noEmit -p test/fixtures
scripts.test: node build.mjs && vitest run && vitest run --config vitest.workers.config.ts
